_comment: Provider adapters are data, not code. Each entry says how to invoke one CLI agent headlessly: `command` + `args` are fixed flags ONLY — the prompt is never one of them; orchestrator.mjs writes it to the child process's stdin instead. Only providers actually installed on this machine are listed: claude (2.1.207) and codex (codex-cli 0.139.0) were both found on PATH and verified against their own --help at scaffold time. Gemini CLI is not installed here and was deliberately left out — add it (see _extension_pattern) if it's installed later. No agent in roster.json currently uses 'codex' — it's listed here so an agent can be reassigned to it later without touching this file again.

claude.description: Claude Code, headless single-prompt mode, prompt via stdin
claude.verify_note: verified live against claude 2.1.207 (the exact version installed on this machine): `-p` with no positional prompt argument reads the prompt from stdin, and --dangerously-skip-permissions is the correct no-prompt-approval flag — required for unattended runs since nothing is present to answer a permission prompt
claude.usageLimitNote: Case-insensitive regexes matched against invokeProvider's combined stdout+stderr by orchestrator.mjs's isUsageLimitHit. A real limit hit was previously observed to produce "You've hit your session limit · resets HH:MMam/pm (your timezone)" — the two originally-guessed patterns didn't match that exact wording, so both the matching and the original patterns are kept here. Re-check again if the exact wording changes in a future CLI version.

codex.description: OpenAI Codex CLI, headless exec mode, prompt via stdin
codex.verify_note: verified live against codex-cli 0.139.0 (the exact version installed on this machine): `codex exec --help` documents that omitting the PROMPT argument (or passing `-`) reads instructions from stdin; --full-auto does NOT exist on this version, the correct flag is --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox. Re-check against the installed version before relying on this if codex is ever upgraded.
codex.usageLimitNote: NOT verified against a real limit hit on this project — based on documentation only. Re-verify against a real hit before trusting this in an unattended run.

_extension_pattern._comment: To add Gemini CLI or another provider later: install it, then add an entry with this shape. Three things must be true: a genuinely non-interactive single-prompt mode (exits on its own, doesn't wait on a TTY); reads its prompt from stdin when no prompt argument is given (never pass a multi-line prompt as a CLI argument); and some flag that skips interactive approval.
args: <flags — no prompt placeholder, stdin carries it>
_extension_pattern.verify_note: <what you checked and against which version>
